title: Capricor’s regulatory odyssey for DMD cell therapy hits second FDA rejection
snippet: A new proposed indication was not enough to get deramiocel across the regulatory finish line. The FDA has again turned away the cell therapy, which is being developed for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, for the second time in as many years.

title: Drug-tolerant persister states in pancreatic cancer and their therapeutic vulnerabilities.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) rapidly develops therapeutic resistance, leading to frequent relapse even after an initial response to treatment. Drug-tolerant persister cells represent a transient and plastic population that survives cytotoxic pressure through reversible adaptive programs and may subsequently give rise to stable resistant disease.....

title: Primary sclerosing cholangitis: epidemiology, risk factors, pathophysiology, clinical features, diagnosis, and management.
